author: IGN
description:
In today's Daily Fix:
Cyberpunk 2077 is getting another update, this time for the PS5 Pro. The new update brings enhanced ray tracing, more framerate options, and 4K resolution for the first time on console. The update is free, and the game itself is free if you're a PS Plus Extra or Essentials member. In sadder news, Sony Pictures Entertainment went through a round of layoffs this morning. Hundreds of employees were affected, but no word yet on how this impacts their adaptations of hit games like Ghost of Tsushima and Helldivers 2. And finally, a Pokémon Go Regional Championship match has fans in an uproar as the winner was disqualified hours after he won.

#IGN #Gaming #PS5
title: Cyberpunk 2077's PS5 Pro Upgrades Detailed - IGN Daily Fix

description:
Bethesda’s massive space RPG has finally landed on PlayStation 5 consoles. Check out the first look at Starfield running on the PS5 Pro, featuring the new "Enhanced" graphics setting. From the bustling, high-density streets of New Atlantis to the lethal silence of dogfights in orbit, we put the hardware to the test to see how the console handles the Settled Systems.

author: IGN
description:
Exit 8 tracks an anonymous subway rider known only as The Lost Man as he emerges from his morning commute into a subway corridor bound for Exit 8, his portal to a temp job in the outside world. 

But something is preventing him from finding the exit — unless he can spot various anomalies within the corridor, he’s doomed to repeat the errors of his past in a Möbius strip–like labyrinth of warped time and space. 

Along the way, The Lost Man encounters other figures, including a wandering company man, a confused little boy, and a beautiful woman — all of whom could be figments of his imagination or anomalies in their own right.

Directed by Genki Kawamura. Based on the global hit eponymous video game created by Kotake Create.

NEON will release Exit 8 in theaters on April 10, 2026.
title: Exit 8: Exclusive Clip (2026) Kazunari Ninomiya

description:
Introducing Zombuds, an open-world business sim that takes place 15 years after a zombie apocalypse. So what business are you simulating? Well, the game name gives you your first clue... More specifically, developer Gamecraft Studios says you'll be making "drugs, meds, and bizarre apocalyptic substances." You'll hire survivors to help grow the business into an empire and/or brainwash zombies into doing the work you need. Plus, your friends can join in the fun in co-op play.

author: IGN
description:
There's often a tricky balance with examining what to re-examine and what to keep when remaking games, but the Gothic 1 Remake from Alkimia Interactive certainly looks to give the original series a much needed reappraisal in the right ways. Along with leaning even further into the stories that are made with every choice, it's making some commendable updates for storytelling and removing some unsavory aspects of the 2001 version. And so far, Gothic 1 Remake has the makings for a worthy reinvention of a classic RPG series. Previewed by Alessandro Fillari

#IGN #Gaming
title: Gothic 1 Remake Preview: A New Look for a Dark-Fantasy RPG Classic

description:
Take a look at the Game of Thrones: Dragonfire announcement trailer for this upcoming free-to-play mobile strategy game based on the Emmy Award-winning original drama series, House of the Dragon. Game of Thrones: Dragonfire will be available on the App Store and Google Play, and pre-registration is available now.

Drawing inspiration from events portrayed in House of the Dragon, players will experience a new narrative as a Valyrian descendant tasked with hatching, raising and flying dragons. Fans will encounter both familiar faces and original characters, form alliances and factions with other players, as well as engage in tactical battles to become a true dragonrider and dominant force in Westeros.

#GameOfThronesDragonfire #Gaming #IGN
